origin.description: Draw arrows from (x, y) by scale times (u, v).
origin.usage: quiver(x, y, u, v, scale=0.05, angle=10, length=0.1)
origin.details: The arrow ends. R time is that series, not a graphics device.
origin.value: Draw arrows from (x, y) by scale times (u, v).
origin.example: { x <- c(0,1); y <- c(0,0); u <- c(1,0); v <- c(0,1); scale <- 0.05; pdf(file.path(tempdir(),"p.pdf")); plot(c(0,1), c(0,0.05), type="n"); quiver(x,y,u,v, scale=scale); dev.off(); c(x+scale*u, y+scale*v) }
